name: Winter, Team Player
description: An Echoverse survivor and cunning leader in Duskmourn who hunts Marina Vendrell to rescue her from herself.

relations.quote: Winter now believes that defeating Marina Vendrell will reverse all the deaths caused by her control over Valgavoth.
